description: Every field a call to granite may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

actions.description: what a page does: `refresh = try await feed.load(page: 1)`, `more = …`, `open(post Post) = …`, `compose "New Post" square.and.pencil = …`

body.description: a blank page's body as Swift, written as given: the view the app has, filled from the page's relays and actions (`FeedView(posts: feed.state.posts, actions: …)`)

bundleId.description: the app's bundle identifier; com.example.<name> when left out: project

destinations.description: the app's places, one a line: `feed: Feed "Feed" house`; `| Detail` names the view beside it in the split style

events.description: a service's work, one a line: `load(page Int) -> posts = API.posts(page: page) "loads a page"`; `+> posts` appends; with no `= call` the host's model writes the work

imports.description: modules the files import beside Foundation, SwiftUI and Granite; a local package's are found on their own

into.description: the folder, relative to the project; Services/<Type> or Components/<Type> when left out; a kit's folder (`Packages/RecipeKit`) puts a public service in the kit

layout.description: how a page draws: list, grid, detail, form, settings, search, compose, tabs, threePane, blank

make.description: what to make: project (a new iOS + macOS app), package (a kit of services), link (Granite into an Xcode project this agent did not make), service, component (a page), navigation, modals

name.description: the app's or the kit's name, letters and digits, like `Recipes`: project and package

notes.description: what the work or the page is for, in a sentence: what the host's model writes bodies from

packages.description: remote packages the app links, pinned: `https://github.com/kean/Nuke@<40-hex revision> Nuke NukeUI`

persist.description: whether a service's state is kept between launches

relays.description: the services a service's work calls or a page reads: `feed: FeedService` or `Feed`

root.description: the root page; Home when left out

rounds.description: how many answers the host's model may give one body before the call is refused; 3 when left out

shows.description: what a page draws: `items = feed.state.posts`, `item = …`, `selection = feed.state.selected`, `title = "Feed"`, `empty = "No posts yet"`; a row of a form `"Section/Label" = config.state.field`

state.description: fields, one a line, in the models syntax: `posts [Post] = []`, `selected String?`; a page's `let post Post` is an input it is made with

style.description: how the app moves between destinations: adaptive (tabs on iPhone, a sidebar on iPad and Mac), tabs, sidebar, split

team.description: the 10-character Apple team id the app signs with: project

type.description: the service (`Feed` makes FeedService) or the page (`Feed`) to make

views.description: a page's subviews: `row(post Post, vote (Bool) -> Void) "title, author and score, with a vote"`; a closure is an action the view sends up with `bubble`, routed by the page to the action of its name; a description is what the host's model writes the body from

title: What granite takes (craft-agent/1)
